title: LoRA memory and shimming
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for compiling post-cutoff Task Objects into leakage-checked parametric-memory LoRA training pairs, choosing between prompt/context shimming, weight updates and hybrid routing, and evaluating pre-registered holdout paired bootstrap CI promotion gates.
boundaries: Compiled training pairs and synthetic smoke evaluations are never presented as admitted adapters or proven model improvements.
Training pairs must pass 4-gram Jaccard disjointness against pre-registered holdouts before any weight update is evaluated.
Fast-churning or instantly revocable facts route to prompt/context shims rather than LoRA weights.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for compiling post-cutoff Task Objects into LoRA pairs, routing between shims and weight updates, and gating promotion on holdout bootstrap CIs

value.lets_workers: Decide whether post-cutoff knowledge belongs in a revocable prompt shim, a parametric LoRA adapter or a hybrid combination, compile direct-recall, supersession-contrast and scope-abstention pairs verified disjoint from holdouts, and gate promotion on paired bootstrap 95 percent confidence intervals.

flow.when: Evaluate churn half-life, query frequency and token amortization before training.
Compile verified post-cutoff Task Objects into leakage-checked SFT pairs.
Gate candidate weights or shims on pre-registered holdout bootstrap CIs and retention floors.

value.worked_example: Synthetic 2-object post-cutoff bundle recomputed in test_lora_memory.py: compiles 6 pairs (direct, supersession, abstention) with zero holdout leakage, selects hybrid_shim_and_lora, and verifies paired bootstrap promotion gates.

nouns.title: Guardrail: never present a compiled pair set or smoke run as a proven model improvement
nouns.category_reason: Enforces honest separation between dataset preparation and statistically gated promotion.

value.rule: A candidate adapter passes only when paired bootstrap 95 percent CI lower bounds clear target gain (>= +0.05), general retention (>= -0.015) and hallucination rate (<= 0.02) on pre-registered holdouts.
value.how_it_is_checked: evaluate_promotion_gate checks all three bounds simultaneously and lists any failed gate.

nouns.title: Guardrail: training prompts must remain n-gram disjoint from pre-registered holdout prompts
nouns.category_reason: Prevents memorization of holdout phrasing from inflating post-cutoff gains.

value.rule: Every compiled training prompt has zero exact match and 4-gram Jaccard <= 0.35 against every holdout prompt.
value.how_it_is_checked: check_holdout_disjointness scans all train-holdout pairs and blocks promotion on any collision.

nouns.title: Guardrail: facts with half-life under 14 days or instant revocation needs stay in prompt shims
nouns.category_reason: Prevents baking transient version numbers or revocable policies into model weights.

value.rule: When churn_half_life_days < 14 or requires_instant_revocation is true, route_adaptation_strategy selects prompt_context_shim regardless of query volume.
value.how_it_is_checked: route_adaptation_strategy enforces the volatility and revocation check before amortization.

nouns.title: Specification: shim-vs-LoRA routing policy and paired bootstrap (B=1000) promotion gates
nouns.category_reason: Defines deterministic thresholds for routing and holdout statistical gating.

nouns.title: Compilation rules: direct recall, supersession contrast and scope abstention SFT pairs
nouns.category_reason: Zero-call transformation from pinned post-cutoff Task Objects to balanced training pairs.

nouns.title: Tool card: post-cutoff LoRA compiler, shim router and bootstrap gate evaluator
nouns.category_reason: Tested Python standard-library package pinned by path, file count and digest.

value.name: LoRA memory and shimming
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
does: Routes adaptation requests across prompt_context_shim, lora_weight_update and hybrid_shim_and_lora.
Compiles direct, supersession and abstention SFT pairs and verifies 4-gram Jaccard disjointness against holdouts.
Computes seeded paired bootstrap 95 percent CIs for target gain, general retention and hallucination rate.
does_not: Run GPU gradient updates, mutate deployed model weights or claim unverified benchmark improvements.

nouns.title: Template: LoRA vs shim routing and holdout bootstrap gate decision

value.describes: a deterministic record of compiled pair count, holdout disjointness, chosen adaptation strategy and paired bootstrap promotion gate result

nouns.title: Worked example input: synthetic post-cutoff Task Objects, routing spec and pre-registered holdout scores

task_objects.subject: Worker RPC v2 batch envelope
task_objects.canonical_fact: batchInvoke requires an idempotencyKey header and caps payloads at 256 KiB

holdout_prompts: Construct a valid Worker RPC v2 batchInvoke call and state its payload ceiling.
Which manifest pruning mode runs by default on a Catalog Iceberg query?

nouns.title: Worked example output: recomputed hybrid routing and paired bootstrap gate decision

verbs.title: Choose prompt/context shimming, LoRA weight update or hybrid routing
verbs.summary: Compare knowledge churn half-life, daily query volume, context shim token overhead and instant-revocation needs against LoRA training cost to choose the right adaptation mechanism.
verbs.outcome: Selected strategy, horizon token amortization and breakeven query count.

slots.name: routing_spec
slots.description: Pin of churn, volume and token budget parameters.

steps: Run python -m lora_memory route on the workload and churn parameters.

verbs.title: Compile verified post-cutoff Task Objects into leakage-checked LoRA pairs
verbs.summary: Generate direct-fact, supersession-guard and scope-abstention SFT pairs from pinned post-cutoff Task Objects and verify 4-gram Jaccard disjointness against pre-registered holdouts.
verbs.outcome: Compiled SFT pairs and holdout disjointness audit.

slots.name: post_cutoff_bundle
slots.description: Pin of verified post-cutoff Task Objects and holdout prompt list.

steps: Compile direct, supersession and abstention pairs with compile_post_cutoff_pairs.
Verify disjoint == true via check_holdout_disjointness before allowing training.

acceptance.check: check_holdout_disjointness returns disjoint == true with max_observed_jaccard <= 0.35.

verbs.title: Evaluate paired bootstrap CI promotion gates on pre-registered holdouts
verbs.summary: Run 1,000 seeded paired bootstrap resamples comparing candidate versus baseline scores on target holdouts and general-capability retention, enforcing gain, retention and hallucination gates.
verbs.outcome: A conforming gate-decision record stating promote true or false and all CI bounds.

slots.name: holdout_evaluation
slots.description: Pin of paired baseline and candidate item scores on target and retention suites.

steps: Run evaluate_promotion_gate with seed=42 and n_bootstrap=1000.
Validate the decision summary against template.gate-decision.

acceptance.check: evaluate_promotion_gate with seed=42 reproduces target_gain_ci_low and promote.
